admitted_actions.finding: quality_preserving is False for 610/610 decisions. Every quality-gated recommendation (session_treatment, cache_treatment) therefore reads 'insufficient_evidence' for the whole population, and no cost-reducing action is admitted anywhere in the organic set.

counterfactual_baseline.method: The counterfactual baseline is the observed behaviour itself: for every one of the 610 decisions the contract either preserves current treatment or withholds a recommendation for insufficient evidence. There is therefore no recommendation-vs-actual divergence to measure on the quality floor, and the actual/counterfactual delta is exactly zero by construction, not by measurement.
counterfactual_baseline.note: recommended_soft_budget_present splits the population by outcome=='success' (see policy.py _envelope gating), so its two profiles restate that split and are NOT independent evidence.
